description: Fetches credit scores and full bureau reports for individual borrowers from TransUnion CIBIL, India's most widely used credit bureau. Used in loan origination workflows to assess creditworthiness, repayment history, active loan accounts, days-past-due (DPD) patterns, and credit utilization. Mandated by most Indian lenders under RBI credit risk assessment guidelines. Provides a CIBIL score between 300-900; scores above 750 are typically considered prime.
use_cases: Checking outstanding loans and default history before disbursal
compliance_context: RBI Master Direction on Credit Information. Requires borrower consent before pull. Covered under Credit Information Companies (Regulation) Act, 2005.
typical_callers: Banks, NBFCs, fintech lenders, microfinance institutions, co-lending platforms, digital lending apps, credit card issuers
auth_description: OAuth2 client credentials flow. Client ID and secret exchanged for a bearer token before each API call.

required_fields.description: Customer PAN for bureau identity lookup
Full name exactly as per PAN card
Date of Birth for identity matching

optional_fields.description: Email ID for better identity matching
Timestamp when borrower provided consent for bureau pull
Loan type for which enquiry is being made

active_accounts.description: Number of currently active loan accounts

dpd_history.description: Month-level arrays of Days Past Due objects

total_outstanding.description: Total principal outstanding across all loans

credit_utilization.description: Percentage utilization of revolving credit limits

enquiry_count.description: Count of hard enquiries in last 3 months

risk_category.description: Label such as High Risk, Sub-prime, Prime

score_factors.description: Array of strings explaining score drivers
